# Muse Code SDK

Murage's Muse Code engine (`server/drivers/muse-code.ts`) uses Meta's
`@muse-code/sdk` 1.4.14 (MIT, Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and
affiliates) to speak the Muse Session Protocol to a Muse Code CLI the owner
installs from Meta. The SDK is bundled into the server; the CLI never is. The
licence text is in `LICENSE`.
